message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build Artifacts

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, build-test, build-artifacts ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 25

      - name: Set jadx version
        run: |
          JADX_REV=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
          JADX_VERSION="r${JADX_REV}.${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
          echo "JADX_VERSION=$JADX_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build
        run: ./gradlew dist -PjadxBundleType=app
        env:
          JADX_BUILD_JAVA_VERSION: 11

      - name: Save bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ format('jadx-{0}', env.JADX_VERSION) }}
          path: build/jadx-*.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          archive: false

  build-win-bundle:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: oracle-actions/setup-java@v1
        with:
          release: 25

      - name: Print Java version
        shell: bash
        run: java -version

      - name: Set jadx version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          JADX_REV=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
          JADX_VERSION="r${JADX_REV}.${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
          echo "JADX_VERSION=$JADX_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build NO-JRE bundle
        run: ./gradlew dist -PjadxBundleType=win-no-jre

      - name: Save Windows bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ format('jadx-gui-{0}-no-jre-win', env.JADX_VERSION) }}
          path: build/distWin/jadx-gui-*.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          archive: false

      - name: Build JRE bundle
        run: ./gradlew dist -PbundleJRE=true -PjadxBundleType=win-jre

      - name: Save JRE bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ format('jadx-gui-{0}-with-jre-win', env.JADX_VERSION) }}
          path: build/distWinWithJre/jadx-gui-*.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          archive: false

      # Prepare build for 'msi' bundle
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Install WiX Toolset
        run: |
          dotnet tool install wix --global --version 5.0.2
          wix extension add --global WixToolset.Util.wixext/5.0.2
          wix extension add --global WixToolset.UI.wixext/5.0.2
          wix.exe --version

      - name: Build msi bundle
        run: ./gradlew :jadx-gui:jpackage -PjadxBundleType=msi

      - name: Save msi artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ format('jadx-gui-{0}.msi', env.JADX_VERSION) }}
          path: jadx-gui/build/jpackage/jadx-gui-*.msi
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          # nightly.link support only '.zip' artifacts, issue: https://github.com/oprypin/nightly.link/issues/88
          # archive: false

  build-mac-bundle:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ macos-latest, macos-15-intel ]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 25

      - name: Set jadx version
        run: |
          JADX_REV=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
          JADX_VERSION="r${JADX_REV}.${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
          echo "JADX_VERSION=$JADX_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build
        run: ./gradlew distMac -PjadxBundleType=dmg

      - name: Save macOS DMG artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ format('jadx-gui-{0}-mac-{1}', env.JADX_VERSION, runner.arch) }}
          path: build/distMac/*.dmg
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          # nightly.link support only '.zip' artifacts, issue: https://github.com/oprypin/nightly.link/issues/88
          # archive: false",
  "rationale": "All three jobs build with Gradle, so repeated dependency fetching occurs on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE experiment (batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) measured adding a Gradle dependency cache step via actions/cache@v4 and reported a 20.4% elapsed-time reduction (98s to 78s) with all runs still succeeding, on a measured CI workflow fork. Adding the same cache step after Setup Gradle and before Build in each job preserves every existing build, test, and artifact step and coverage, introduces no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access beyond Gradle's existing dependency resolution, and keys the cache on runner OS plus the Gradle files/wrapper properties so dependency changes invalidate it appropriately.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
